title: Petersen graph: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 19 gates computes its edge function
unlocks: The exact size on the smallest cubic graph of girth 5; on paper the answer, either way, decides three open statements of the exact-size line at once
context: Hard and open; a conjecture, it may be false. A circuit with 19 gates refutes it and is as welcome as a proof. Known: a circuit with 20 gates exists. In-house reach (computed, not checked): split by the first gate up to the automorphisms of the graph into five cases; each case was run for ten minutes and none was decided; no circuit with 19 gates was found. With NOT allowed, the AND of two non-adjacent inputs is a real first-gate case. 10 inputs, 15 edges, cover number 6. No sorry, no new axiom. Put every declaration of your file inside its own namespace.
shard_spec:
0: first gate an AND of the two ends of an edge: exclude 19 gates or find a circuit
1: first gate an OR of the two ends of an edge
2: first gate an OR of two non-adjacent inputs
3: first gate a NOT of an input
4: first gate an AND of two non-adjacent inputs
